title: Space Challenge
description: Embark on an interstellar journey through black holes, cosmic rays, nebulae, galaxies, and space missions.
seoTitle: Space Challenge Quiz – Astronomy & Cosmic Trivia | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: Explore astronomy, NASA missions, black holes, and the universe in this 10-question Space Challenge quiz.

questions.question: What is the boundary around a black hole beyond which nothing, not even light, can escape?
questions.explanation: The event horizon is the threshold where the escape velocity of the gravitational field equals the speed of light.

questions.question: What is the closest spiral galaxy to our Milky Way galaxy?
questions.explanation: Andromeda (M31) is approximately 2.5 million light-years from Earth and is the nearest major spiral galaxy to the Milky Way.

questions.question: Which space telescope was launched on Christmas Day 2021 as the successor to Hubble?
questions.explanation: The James Webb Space Telescope was launched December 25, 2021, providing high-resolution infrared views of the early universe.

questions.question: Who was the first human being to travel into outer space in 1961?
questions.explanation: Soviet cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin completed one orbit of Earth aboard Vostok 1 on April 12, 1961.

questions.question: What is the primary element fueling nuclear fusion in the core of our Sun?
questions.explanation: The Sun fuses hydrogen nuclei (protons) into helium at its core via the proton-proton chain reaction.

questions.question: What is a light-year a unit of?
questions.explanation: A light-year is a unit of astronomical distance: the distance that light travels in a vacuum in one Julian year (approx. 9.46 trillion km).

questions.question: What astronomical body is located at the center of our Milky Way galaxy?
options: A supermassive black hole named Sagittarius A*
questions.explanation: Sagittarius A* is a supermassive black hole containing approximately 4 million solar masses located at the Milky Way's galactic center.

questions.question: Which robotic rover landed in Jezero Crater on Mars in February 2021 searching for ancient biosignatures?
questions.explanation: NASA's Perseverance rover touched down in Jezero Crater on February 18, 2021, accompanied by the Ingenuity helicopter.

questions.question: What is the name of the cosmic explosion that marks the violent gravitational collapse of a massive dying star?
questions.explanation: A supernova is a catastrophic stellar explosion producing an outburst of energy outshining an entire galaxy.

questions.question: What theoretical structure in general relativity provides a hypothetical shortcut connecting distant points in spacetime?
questions.explanation: An Einstein-Rosen bridge, commonly called a wormhole, is a speculative topological feature creating a shortcut through spacetime.
